subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence to fill in the blank.

The police thought that the theft was __deliberate__, but it was _________.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"deliberate"** means something done consciously and intentionally. (जानबूझकर)

 
 
• **Example: **The deliberate act of vandalism was caught on the security camera.
 
 
 
• **"Unintentional" **refers to something not done on purpose or not intended. (अनजाने में)
 
 
• **Example: **His unintentional mistake caused a lot of confusion during the meeting.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'deliberate' **is **'unintentional'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Planned **(योजना बनाई गई): Decided on and arranged in advance.

 
 
• **Example:** The event was well planned and executed flawlessly.
 
 
 
• **Expected **(अपेक्षित): Regarded as likely to happen.
 
 
• **Example: **His promotion was expected after his excellent performance.
 
 
 
• **Prepared** (तैयार): Made ready for use or consideration.
 
 
• **Example:** She was well prepared for the upcoming exam.
 
 

37:Tb15,

The correct answer is: **Option 1** i
